newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W Manila unit sets up firm to install lines.
newsitem.headline: C&W Manila unit sets up firm to install lines.

text.p: International gateway operator Eastern Telecommunications Phils Inc (ETPI), an affiliate of Cable & Wireless plc, had created a wholly owned subsidiary to operate its local exchange operations, documents submitted to the Board of Investments on Monday said.
Telecommunications Technologies Phils Inc (TTPI) will install, operate and maintain 300,000 local lines in northern Philippines starting February next year.
TTPI is seeking a three-year income tax holiday, preferential tariff rates on the importation of its capital equipment and tax credit on its domestic capital equipment from the Board of Investments.
The company has an authorised capital of 430 millin pesos.
